data.one_liner: A Telegram utility for Flutter supporting URL schemes and Bot API integration.
data.what_it_does: Provides client-side URL schemes and server-side Telegram Bot API integration. Enables message sending, media sharing, chat management, webhook handling, and Web App support within Flutter applications.
use_when: You need to integrate Telegram Bot API features into your Flutter application.
You want to use Telegram URL schemes for opening chats, joining channels, or sharing content.
avoid_when: You require a general-purpose chat UI kit rather than a Telegram wrapper.
You need a backend infrastructure that is not tied to Telegram.
strengths: Comprehensive coverage of Telegram Bot API methods.
Includes both client-side URL schemes and server-side bot operations.
weaknesses: Requires external setup such as obtaining a bot token from BotFather.
Tied exclusively to the Telegram ecosystem.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting a bot token using Telegram.setBotToken() for Bot API features.
